newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia sells spa businesses at $1.5 million.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia sells spa businesses at $1.5 million.

text.p: Tunisia sold off three state-owned hotels and one business in the spa sector for 1.5 million dinars ($1.54 million) as part of its privatisation programme, officials said on Thursday.
The three hotels and the business are located in the coastal spa resort of Korbous, 30 km (18 miles) south east of Tunis, and were managed by the state's Office du Thermalisme.
The tender was launched last January.
Officials said that results of two other tenders for the selling off of two spa resorts and their hotels in Djebel Oust and Hammam-Bourguiba are expected within one or two weeks. ($=0.97 dinar)
